tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, behind the contour background. Every page is dark: there is no light theme.

tokens.name: topo-dim
tokens.usage: Overlay laid over the contour background on web pages (60%). Keeps body text readable while the lines stay visible.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, boxes and panels that sit on the contour background.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque panel: menus, sticky bars, booking box.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline border on panels and dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlined (secondary) buttons, chips, tags.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and strong text on bg or panel.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Body text on bg or panel.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, small labels, metadata.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: THE brand green, from the logo. Action only: primary buttons, the 40x3px bar under headings, focus rings, hover underline in menus. White text on it.

tokens.name: green-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green used AS TEXT on the dark ground (links, small green words), where #009a44 is too dark to read.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Attention, small accents only: the current-page underline in menus, dots on Road tour tags, early-bird label. Never whole blocks, never Italian-flag stripes.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red used AS TEXT on the dark ground: the small uppercase labels above headings (eyebrows), numbers in lists. Brighter than #E10600 so small text stays readable.

tokens.name: gravel
tokens.usage: Dot on Gravel tour tags and the Gravel filter chip.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Stars: review ratings, Matteo's titles, the 'Event entry guaranteed' badge. Nothing else.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, tags and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and panels.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between page sections on desktop (52px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small badges and labels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and form fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, photos.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Wide photo bands.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, filter chips, title chips.
